slots.hypothesis: The core is the minute-turnover centroid, i.e. when in the day trading happens. Its 20-day slow component alone scores +1.27, and it is the measured quantity inside both of the strongest heads (+1.77 and +1.64). The family control removes head 1 and head 2, so only timing information beyond the level earns score. Snapshot peripheries were only cs_bucket_zscore / cs_bucket_rank plus ts_mean / ts_max. This slot uses four unseen kinds of periphery, with 16 pairwise-distinct operator sets: (A) timing drift against the stock's own history (241-day median, 120-day z, 20-day change); (B) timing instability and tail (40-day std, right tail minus median, day-to-day autocorrelation); (C) co-movement of timing with daily return, turnover and the overnight gap, plus the Amt-vs-Volume centroid gap; (D) the slow core used as a 'same-timing peer' grouping variable, with timing dispersion (day_wstd of in_index), peak minute, lot grid, minute-Amt autocorrelation, 5-day reversal and a rank interaction with minute-return autocorrelation compared inside each group. Literature: Bogousslavsky 2016, Qiu-Huang-Jiang 2023-06, Lou-Polk-Skouras, Han et al. 2022, BlackRock 2020-07, Freyberger et al.

In round 2's same-treatment test, every surviving measured quantity depended on minute order or on repeated values (timing, lag-1 autocorrelation, distinct ratio), and every order-invariant share or concentration statistic died. This slot changes only the measured quantity, to order-dependent minute statistics this seed has never touched: volatility timing (centroid of |Ret| and of High-Low, corr of time with |Ret|), Hurst of minute Ret and Amt, multi-lag serial dependence (Ljung-Box Q dispersion, lag-5 corr, 5/1 and 10/1 minute variance ratios), clustering of |Ret|, volume-return lead-lag (Amt-weighted continuation, lagged Amt vs Ret and |Ret|), and intraday path linearity. It reuses only the two treatments this seed has validated: z within decile groups (market cap, liquidity, noise or the granularity envelope) followed by a 79-day max or a 20-day mean. It leaves out volume timing, which belongs to the E slot, and leaves out DW / AR1 / autocorr of Amt, which the library would block. Literature: Roll 1984-09, Eom et al. 2007-12, Hasbrouck 1991-03, Subrahmanyam 2008, Asparouhova et al. 2010, and Stachowiak 2004 as a counter-example.
